name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the Quantum Fourier Transform on 3
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement the Quantum Fourier Transform on 3 qubits from scratch in Qiskit (Hadamards, controlled phases, swaps). Verify it against the exact DFT matrix using Operator. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
